224:t_1:87.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I never expected to hear those words here too...」

224:t_1:88.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Do you know something about it?」

224:t_1:89.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I believe Miss $$ミレーヌ$$ has given you an outline of our fighting on Earth, but...」

224:t_1:90.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「During those battles, we repeatedly heard about the universe collapsing once every 12,000 years.」

224:t_1:91.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「They said it was the universe's rebirth, and that $$バアル$$ appeared in time with it...」

224:t_1:92.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Ah, $$バアル$$... The natural enemy of intelligent life, recorded even in $$プロトカルチャー$$ texts...」

224:t_1:93.en:
$$マックス$$
「Chief of Staff $$エキセドル$$'s research suggests that the energy life-forms' arrival from the $$サブ・ユニバース$$ was also...」

224:t_1:94.en:
$$マックス$$
「Caused by dimensional distortions resulting from that collapse of the universe every 12,000 years.」

224:t_1:95.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But it appears the universe has not actually collapsed...」

224:t_1:96.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Correct. Within the scope of my research, disasters powerful enough to shake space-time, and abnormal outbreaks of $$バアル$$...」

224:t_1:97.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Have caused intelligent species to go extinct or regress. But at least, they cannot really be called a collapse in which everything was lost.」

224:t_1:98.en:
$$マックス$$
「However, something certainly happens once every 12,000 years.」

224:t_1:99.en:
$$ブライト$$
「And it could cause humanity to perish...」

224:t_1:100.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「Correct. The universe may survive, but the future of the life within it is not guaranteed...」

224:t_1:101.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「And the rising frequency of $$バアル$$ outbreaks indicates that this once-in-12,000-years crisis is approaching.」

224:t_1:102.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The enemies beyond human understanding we encountered on Earth... Those who called themselves gods said something similar.」

224:t_1:103.en:
$$エキセドル$$
「What we should do now is gather the information left by those who came before us.」

224:t_1:104.en:
$$マックス$$
「This ship has left the fleet and is operating alone to carry out that investigation.」

224:t_1:108.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar～

224:t_1:109.en:
$$ガロード$$
「...So that's why we're joining the expedition to investigate the collapse of the universe.」

224:t_1:110.en:
$$パーラ$$
「Shouldn't getting back to Earth come before that?」

224:t_1:111.en:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, we can't easily figure out how long it would take, even with folding.」

224:t_1:112.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「For those calculations, we must rely on the $$マクロス７船団$$'s data on this area. But problems remain, such as the energy required.」

224:t_1:113.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Even if we solve those, each fold requires preparation for the next. The journey back to Earth would probably take years.」

224:t_1:115.en:
$$パーラ$$
「But you and the $$フロンティア船団$$ got sent straight to Earth, Captain $$ガムリン$$.」

224:t_1:116.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「That was an exceptional event that we can only call a mystery of the universe. Human power can't accomplish that.」

224:t_1:118.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We'll be fine, $$ティファ$$. It might take time, but there is a way home.」

224:t_1:121.en:
$$ティファ$$
「I can't explain it well... but I'm scared...」

224:t_1:123.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Do you sense something on the planet we're going to investigate...?」

224:t_1:124.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Even if she does, we have to go. If someone's telling us the universe might end, we can't just ignore it.」

224:t_1:125.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Exactly. The universe ending once every 12,000 years is a serious matter for us too.」

224:t_1:126.en:
$$オズマ$$
「So we'll help with the $$バトル７$$'s operation. I wouldn't call it payment in return, but the fleet will also help us get home.」

224:t_1:127.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Well, we are suited to the task. $c encountered a lot of things like that during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

224:t_1:128.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Combined with the information we have, we might learn something.」

224:t_1:129.en:
$$レド$$
「So we're heading for a planet said to have $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins.」

224:t_1:130.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Quit looking so glum, $$レド$$! Treasure's waiting for us!」

224:t_1:131.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You're getting too excited, $$ピニオン$$. This isn't a treasure hunt.」

224:t_1:132.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「What are you talking about!? Places like that are always full of buried treasure!」

224:t_1:134.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「I know all about it, $$ロラン$$. Your mustached doll was dug out of a mountain full of ancient stuff too.」

224:t_1:136.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But, though I don't sound quite like $$ピニオン$$, I'm a little excited too.」

224:t_1:137.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Me too. If we learn a little more about the universe's mysteries, that'll be great.」

224:t_1:138.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Aren't you going back to the $$バトル７$$, $$ミレーヌ$$?」

224:t_1:139.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I'm part of $c now. As long as I know Dad, Mom and the fleet are safe, that's enough.」

224:t_1:140.en:
$$アルト$$
「You're definitely $$バサラ$$'s partner. You do things your own way, wherever you are.」

224:t_1:141.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「I don't like the way you said that...!」

224:t_1:142.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Now, now, $$ミレーヌ$$. We believe these ruins are the same type as those on $$惑星ラクス$$, so we'll need your power.」

224:t_1:144.en:
$$シン$$
「Has $$プラント$$'s songstress become the galaxy's songstress!?」

224:t_1:145.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course not, you two...」

224:t_1:146.en:
$$フォウ$$
「What's this $$惑星ラクス$$? And why do you need $$ミレーヌ$$'s power?」

224:t_1:147.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「《$$惑星ラクス$$》 was a planet with $$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins. It doesn't exist anymore, though...」

224:t_1:148.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「They needed me to open a sealed door in those ruins, because I have both $$ゼントラーディ$$ and human blood.」

224:t_1:149.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$プロトカルチャー$$ ruins require proof of peace... The mingling of different species' blood.」

224:t_1:150.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If that's what they want, isn't the multiverse even more impressive?」

224:t_1:151.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Right. It's a mix of different worlds, not just different planets, all existing together.」

224:t_1:152.en:
$$シン$$
「...But encounters like that also give rise to war...」

224:t_1:153.en:
$$キラ$$
「That might be true now... But it might not be true in the future.」

224:t_1:155.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$キラ$$ is right. People who are fighting now might build peace together in the future.」

224:t_1:156.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「My dad and mom were ace pilots on opposite sides, Earth and the $$ゼントラーディ$$, during the $$第一次星間大戦$$, but...」

224:t_1:157.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Then they got married and had my big sisters and me.」

224:t_1:158.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Two people who were enemies got married, huh...」

224:t_1:159.en:
$$フォウ$$
「That's proof of peace all right.」

224:t_1:160.en:
$$アルト$$
「But I heard Captain $$マックス$$ and Mayor $$ミリア$$ nearly got divorced at one point...」

224:t_1:161.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Don't ruin a nice story!」

224:t_1:162.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Cut him some slack, $$ミレーヌ$$. That's just how he is.」

224:t_1:164.en:
$$シェリル$$
「We've got one more member for the expedition.」

224:t_1:166.en:
$$シェリル$$
「No, I'm not. $$ランカ$$-chan is coming.」
